newsitem.title: ALBANIA: Albania awards Mother Teresa top honour.
newsitem.headline: Albania awards Mother Teresa top honour.

text.p: Albania awarded ailing Mother Teresa its top "Honour of the Nation" order on Thursday for her life-long dedication to the poor, the presidential office said in a statement on Albania's national day.
"(We give the award) to the most renowned Albanian of all times, the living saint of our nation, Mother Teresa," Albanian President Sali Berisha said in a speech celebrating her award.
"(It is) a sign of the deep gratitude the Albanian nation nurtures for the Missionary of God, the symbol of love and hope, its honour and pride," he added.
The 86-year-old Roman Catholic missionary nun, born of Albanian parents as Gonxhe Bojaxhi, is currently in critical condition in an Indian heart clinic.
Popularly known as the "Saint of the Gutters", she began her work in the slums of Calcutta in 1949 and won the Nobel Peace Prize in 1979.
